components.Accordion: Use the Accordion component to display a list of collapsible items.
components.Alert: Use the `title` prop to set the title of the Alert.
components.App: This component implements Reka UI [ConfigProvider](https://reka-ui.com/docs/utilities/config-provider){rel=""nofollow""} to provide global configuration to all components:
components.AuthForm: Built on top of the [Form](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/form) component, the `AuthForm` component can be used in your pages or wrapped in a [PageCard](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/page-card).
components.Avatar: The Avatar uses the `<NuxtImg>` component when [`@nuxt/image`](https://github.com/nuxt/image){rel=""nofollow""} is installed, falling back to `img` otherwise.
components.AvatarGroup: Wrap multiple [Avatar](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/avatar) within an AvatarGroup to stack them.
components.Badge: Use the default slot to set the label of the Badge.
components.Banner: Use the `title` prop to display a title on the Banner.
components.BlogPost: The BlogPost component provides a flexible way to display an `<article>` element with customizable content including title, description, image, etc.
components.BlogPosts: The BlogPosts component provides a flexible layout to display a list of [BlogPost](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/blog-post) components using either the default slot or the `posts` prop.
components.Breadcrumb: Use the Breadcrumb component to show the current page's location in your site's hierarchy.
components.Button: Use the default slot to set the label of the Button.
components.Calendar: Use the `v-model` directive to control the selected date.
components.Card: Use the `header`, `default` and `footer` slots to add content to the Card.
components.Carousel: Use the Carousel component to display a list of items in a carousel.
components.ChangelogVersion: The ChangelogVersion component provides a flexible way to display an `<article>` element with customizable content including title, description, image, etc.
components.ChangelogVersions: The ChangelogVersions component provides a flexible layout to display a list of [ChangelogVersion](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/changelog-version) components using either the default slot or the `versions` prop.
components.ChatMessage: The ChatMessage component renders an `<article>` element for a `user` or `assistant` chat message.
components.ChatMessages: The ChatMessages component displays a list of [ChatMessage](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/chat-message) components using either the default slot or the `messages` prop.
components.ChatPalette: The ChatPalette component is a structured layout wrapper that organizes [ChatMessages](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/chat-messages) in a scrollable content area and [ChatPrompt](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/chat-prompt) in a fixed bottom section, creating cohesive chatbot interfaces for modals, slideovers, or drawers.
components.ChatPrompt: The ChatPrompt component renders a `<form>` element and extends the [Textarea](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/textarea) component so you can pass any property such as `icon`, `placeholder`, `autofocus`, etc.
components.ChatPromptSubmit: The ChatPromptSubmit component is used inside the [ChatPrompt](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/chat-prompt) component to submit the prompt. It automatically handles the different `status` values to control the chat.
components.ChatReasoning: The ChatReasoning component renders a collapsible block that displays AI reasoning or thinking content. It auto-opens during streaming and auto-closes after.
components.ChatShimmer: The ChatShimmer component renders an element with an animated shimmer gradient over text, commonly used to indicate streaming or loading states in chat interfaces.
components.ChatTool: The ChatTool component renders a collapsible block that displays AI tool invocation status, such as "Searching components" or "Reading documentation". When a default slot is provided, it becomes collapsible to reveal tool output.
components.Checkbox: Use the `v-model` directive to control the checked state of the Checkbox.
components.CheckboxGroup: Use the `v-model` directive to control the value of the CheckboxGroup or the `default-value` prop to set the initial value when you do not need to control its state.
components.Chip: Wrap any component with a Chip to display an indicator.
components.Collapsible: Use a [Button](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/button) or any other component in the default slot of the Collapsible.
components.ColorPicker: Use the `v-model` directive to control the value of the ColorPicker.
components.CommandPalette: Use the `v-model` directive to control the value of the CommandPalette or the `default-value` prop to set the initial value when you do not need to control its state.
components.Container: Use the default slot to center and constrain the width of your content.
components.ContextMenu: Use anything you like in the default slot of the ContextMenu, and right-click on it to display the menu.
components.DashboardGroup: The DashboardGroup component is the main layout that wraps the [DashboardSidebar](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/dashboard-sidebar) and [DashboardPanel](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/dashboard-panel) components to create a responsive dashboard interface.
components.DashboardNavbar: The DashboardNavbar component is a responsive navigation bar that integrates with the [DashboardSidebar](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/dashboard-sidebar) component. It includes a mobile toggle button to enable responsive navigation in dashboard layouts.
components.DashboardPanel: The DashboardPanel component is used to display a panel. Its state (size, collapsed, etc.) will be saved based on the `storage` and `storage-key` props you provide to the [DashboardGroup](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/dashboard-group#props) component.
components.DashboardResizeHandle: The DashboardResizeHandle component is used by the [DashboardSidebar](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/dashboard-sidebar) and [DashboardPanel](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/dashboard-panel) components.
components.DashboardSearch: The DashboardSearch component extends the [CommandPalette](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/command-palette) component, so you can pass any property such as `icon`, `placeholder`, etc.
components.DashboardSearchButton: The DashboardSearchButton component is used to open the [DashboardSearch](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/dashboard-search) modal.
components.DashboardSidebar: The DashboardSidebar component is used to display a sidebar in a dashboard layout. It supports drag-to-resize, state persistence and integrates with [DashboardGroup](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/dashboard-group), [DashboardPanel](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/dashboard-panel) and [DashboardNavbar](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/dashboard-navbar).
components.DashboardSidebarCollapse: The DashboardSidebarCollapse component is used to collapse/expand the [DashboardSidebar](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/dashboard-sidebar) component **when its `collapsible` prop is set**.
components.DashboardSidebarToggle: The DashboardSidebarToggle component is used by the [DashboardNavbar](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/dashboard-navbar) and [DashboardSidebar](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/dashboard-sidebar) components.
components.DashboardToolbar: The DashboardToolbar component is used to display a toolbar under the [DashboardNavbar](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/dashboard-navbar) component.
components.Drawer: Use a [Button](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/button) or any other component in the default slot of the Drawer.
components.DropdownMenu: Use a [Button](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/button) or any other component in the default slot of the DropdownMenu.
components.Editor: The Editor component provides a powerful rich text editing experience built on [TipTap](https://tiptap.dev/){rel=""nofollow""}. It supports multiple content formats (JSON, HTML, Markdown), customizable toolbars, drag-and-drop block reordering, slash commands, mentions, emoji picker, and extensible architecture for adding custom functionality.
components.EditorDragHandle: The EditorDragHandle component provides drag-and-drop functionality for reordering editor blocks using the `@tiptap/extension-drag-handle-vue-3` package.
components.EditorEmojiMenu: The EditorEmojiMenu component displays a menu of emoji suggestions when typing the `:` character in the editor and inserts the selected emoji. It works alongside the `@tiptap/extension-emoji` package to provide emoji support.
components.EditorMentionMenu: The EditorMentionMenu component displays a menu of user suggestions when typing a trigger character (defaults to `@`) in the editor and inserts the selected mention using the `@tiptap/extension-mention` package. The trigger character is also used as the prefix when rendering the inserted mention.
components.EditorSuggestionMenu: The EditorSuggestionMenu component displays a menu of formatting and action suggestions when typing a trigger character in the editor and executes the corresponding [handler](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/editor#handlers) when an item is selected.
components.EditorToolbar: The EditorToolbar component displays a toolbar of formatting buttons that automatically sync their active state with the editor content. It supports three layout modes using the `@tiptap/vue-3/menus` package:
components.Empty: Use the Empty component to display a placeholder state when there is no content to show.
components.FieldGroup: Wrap multiple [Button](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/button) within a FieldGroup to group them together.
components.FileUpload: Use the `v-model` directive to control the value of the FileUpload.
components.Footer: The Footer component renders a `<footer>` element.
components.FooterColumns: The FooterColumns component renders a list of columns to display in your Footer.
components.Form: Use the Form component to validate form data using any validation library supporting [Standard Schema](https://github.com/standard-schema/standard-schema){rel=""nofollow""} such as [Valibot](https://github.com/fabian-hiller/valibot){rel=""nofollow""}, [Zod](https://github.com/colinhacks/zod){rel=""nofollow""}, [Regle](https://github.com/victorgarciaesgi/regle){rel=""nofollow""}, [Yup](https://github.com/jquense/yup){rel=""nofollow""}, [Joi](https://github.com/hapijs/joi){rel=""nofollow""} or [Superstruct](https://github.com/ianstormtaylor/superstruct){rel=""nofollow""} or your own validation logic.
components.FormField: Wrap any form component with a FormField. Used in a [Form](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/form), it provides validation and error handling.
components.Header: The Header component renders a `<header>` element.
components.Icon: Use the `name` prop to display an icon.
components.Input: Use the `v-model` directive to control the value of the Input.
components.InputDate: Use the `v-model` directive to control the selected date.
components.InputMenu: Use the `v-model` directive to control the value of the InputMenu or the `default-value` prop to set the initial value when you do not need to control its state.
components.InputNumber: Use the `v-model` directive to control the value of the InputNumber.
components.InputRating: Use the `v-model` directive to control the rating value of the InputRating component.
components.InputTags: Use the `v-model` directive to control the value of the InputTags.
components.InputTime: Use the `v-model` directive to control the selected time.
components.Kbd: Use the default slot to set the value of the Kbd.
components.Link: The Link component is a wrapper around [`<NuxtLink>`](https://nuxt.com/docs/api/components/nuxt-link){rel=""nofollow""} using the [`custom`](https://router.vuejs.org/api/interfaces/RouterLinkProps.html#Properties-custom){rel=""nofollow""} prop. It provides a few extra props:
components.Listbox: Use the `v-model` directive to control the value of the Listbox or the `default-value` prop to set the initial value when you do not need to control its state.
components.Main: The Main component renders a `<main>` element that works together with the [Header](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/header) component to create a full-height layout that extends to the viewport's available height.
components.Marquee: Use the default slot with your content to create an infinite scrolling animation.
components.Modal: Use a [Button](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/button) or any other component in the default slot of the Modal.
components.NavigationMenu: Use the NavigationMenu component to display a list of links horizontally or vertically.
components.Page: The Page component helps you create layouts with optional left and right columns. It's perfect for building documentation sites and other content-focused pages.
components.PageAnchors: Use the PageAnchors component to display a list of links.
components.PageAside: The PageAside component is a sticky `<aside>` element that is only displayed starting from the [`lg` breakpoint](https://tailwindcss.com/docs/breakpoints){rel=""nofollow""}.
components.PageBody: The PageBody component wraps your main content and adds some padding for consistent spacing.
components.PageCard: The PageCard component provides a flexible way to display content in a card with an illustration in the default slot.
components.PageColumns: The PageColumns component displays content in a responsive multi-column layout. It works well with [PageCard](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/page-card) components or any other elements, adapting from single column on mobile to multiple columns on larger screens.
components.PageCTA: The PageCTA component provides a flexible way to display a call to action in your pages with an illustration in the default slot.
components.PageFeature: The PageFeature component is used by the [PageSection](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/page-section) component to display [features](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/page-section#features).
components.PageGrid: The PageGrid component provides a responsive grid layout for displaying [PageCard](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/page-card) components or any other elements, automatically adjusting from 1 to 3 columns based on screen size.
components.PageHeader: The PageHeader component displays a header for your page.
components.PageHero: The PageHero component wraps your content in a [Container](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/container) while maintaining full-width flexibility making it easy to add background colors, images or patterns. It provides a flexible way to display content with an illustration in the default slot.
components.PageLinks: Use the PageLinks component to display a list of links.
components.PageList: The PageList component provides a flexible way to display content in a vertical list layout. It's perfect for creating stacked lists of [PageCard](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/page-card) components or any other elements, with optional dividers between items.
components.PageLogos: The PageLogos component provides a flexible way to display a list of logos or images in your pages.
components.PageSection: The PageSection component wraps your content in a [Container](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/container) while maintaining full-width flexibility making it easy to add background colors, images or patterns. It provides a flexible way to display content with an illustration in the default slot.
components.Pagination: Use the `default-page` prop or the `v-model:page` directive to control the current page.
components.PinInput: Use the `v-model` directive to control the value of the PinInput.
components.Popover: Use a [Button](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/button) or any other component in the default slot of the Popover.
components.PricingPlan: The PricingPlan component provides a flexible way to display a pricing plan with customizable content including title, description, price, features, etc.
components.PricingPlans: The PricingPlans component provides a flexible layout to display a list of [PricingPlan](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/pricing-plan) components using either the default slot or the `plans` prop.
components.PricingTable: The PricingTable component provides a responsive and customizable way to display pricing plans in a table format, automatically switching between a horizontal table layout on desktop for easy comparison and a vertical card layout on mobile for better readability.
components.Progress: Use the `v-model` directive to control the value of the Progress.
components.ProgressGroup: Use the ProgressGroup component to display multiple values as segments of a single progress bar.
components.RadioGroup: Use the `v-model` directive to control the value of the RadioGroup or the `default-value` prop to set the initial value when you do not need to control its state.
components.ScrollArea: The ScrollArea component creates scrollable containers with optional virtualization for large lists.
components.Select: Use the `v-model` directive to control the value of the Select or the `default-value` prop to set the initial value when you do not need to control its state.
components.SelectMenu: Use the `v-model` directive to control the value of the SelectMenu or the `default-value` prop to set the initial value when you do not need to control its state.
components.Separator: Use the Separator component as-is to separate content.
components.Sidebar: The Sidebar component is a standalone, fixed sidebar that pushes the page content. On desktop, it renders inline and can be collapsed; on mobile, it opens a [Modal](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/modal), [Slideover](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/slideover) or [Drawer](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/drawer) component.
components.Skeleton: Use the Skeleton component as-is to display a placeholder.
components.Slideover: Use a [Button](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/button) or any other component in the default slot of the Slideover.
components.Slider: Use the `v-model` directive to control the value of the Slider.
components.Splitter: Use the Splitter component to display a list of resizable panels separated by draggable handles.
components.Stepper: Use the Stepper component to display a list of items in a stepper.
components.Switch: Use the `v-model` directive to control the checked state of the Switch.
components.Table: The Table component is built on top of [TanStack Table v8](https://tanstack.com/table/v8){rel=""nofollow""} and is powered by the [useVueTable](https://tanstack.com/table/v8/docs/framework/vue/vue-table#usevuetable){rel=""nofollow""} composable to provide a flexible and fully type-safe API.
components.Tabs: Use the Tabs component to display a list of items in tabs.
components.Textarea: Use the `v-model` directive to control the value of the Textarea.
components.Theme: The Theme component overrides default **slot classes** and **props** of all child components without modifying each one individually. It uses Vue's `provide` / `inject` mechanism under the hood, so the overrides apply at any depth.
components.Timeline: Use the Timeline component to display a list of items in a timeline.
components.Tooltip: Use a [Button](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/button) or any other component in the default slot of the Tooltip.
components.Tree: Use the Tree component to display a hierarchical structure of items.
components.User: Use the `name` prop to display a name for the user.
